en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Ismail Bin Bazie, from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl, from Abu Al Sabbah Al Kanany, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding
the man and the woman both having been found in one quilt, would both be whipped one hundred, one hundred’.
